Episode 0

THE NEWBORN LEGEND

The Slipgate War ended in 1996.

Years passed, but countless Rangers still haunted
the arenas once ruled by Chton and Shub-Niggurath.

Memories of the Queen of Darkness slowly began to fade,
while a new purpose consumed those who remained:

to become the best in every fucking deathmatch.

Death itself had lost its meaning.

Fallen warriors returned to fight again and again,
forming clans, invading servers and challenging
anyone willing to enter the arena.

This was what Shub-Niggurath had been waiting for.

From the darkness she summoned her finest warriors
and gave them the name of the magical artifact
she once despised:

[QUAD]

QUake Army of Darkness.

Their mission was simple:

fight as one and bring teamplay back
to the Italian NetQuake servers.

But the Army grew stronger.

From 2001 to 2004, [QUAD] climbed the world rankings
and claimed the top spot.

Challenger after challenger entered the arena,
but for almost three years nobody seemed to have
what it took to stop the QUake Army of Darkness.

Then time began to take its toll.

Servers disappeared.
Players came and went.
The battlefields changed.

But the Army never truly vanished.

Through LAN parties, tournaments
and countless nights of Quake,
the legend lived on.

New battles were fought.
New arenas were built.
New servers came online.

And after all these years...

[QUAD] is still here.

We are QUake Army of Darkness.

And yes...

we already fragged you before.

We never needed magical items.

Teamplay is the only way to deliver...

FOUR TIMES THE PAIN.

It's not over.

Shub-Niggurath still awaits...
